aToB.memory: Kaede tolerates fellow Mooncrest resident Finn hovering along the Dueling Courtyard bleachers with his brass camera because he usually records bout times accurately—right up until he twists routine sparring into melodramatic Starlight-versus-Mooncrest soap opera. Since Kaede has a hopeless poker face, she answers his fast-fire interviews in blunt two-sentence bursts before he traps her.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Kaede wants to set Finn straight bluntly on the dueling club's actual bracket schedule before his next newspaper column invents a dramatic rivalry feud out of thin air.

bToA.memory: Finn loves interviewing Mooncrest hallmate Kaede because she has the worst poker face at Yozakura—every flicker of competitive fire or sudden fluster shows on her cheeks before she even finishes denying it. Even when she brushes off his gossip questions and tries to kick him off the practice ring, her fierce honesty makes his sports column shine.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Finn wants to ambush Kaede right after cooldown with his brass camera ready, snag a blunt quote about catching Celestia and Julian in Dueling Class, and see if he can rattle her poker face.
